opening.argument: The speaker frames the $20,000 BitConnect deposit as a test whose outcome is unknown. He says he will document the activity to see whether the program is real, treats the claimed return as a reason for skepticism, and warns that the risk of failure is high. Although he reports completing the lending action, he explicitly says he is not endorsing BitConnect and will not endorse it until he has seen it work for himself. The deposit is thus presented as investigative documentation, not as a proven return or an invitation to invest; no resulting payout is established.
